summary: Mobile-only run for iteration 4 covering the 3 new enhancements + regression on Expo web preview (https://smart-golf-gps.expo.preview.emergentagent.com, viewport 390x844). BACKEND (12/12 pass, /app/backend/tests/test_share_import.py): POST /api/courses/{id}/share returns a valid 6-char code (alphabet A-HJ-NP-Z2-9), idempotent, 404 on unknown id, shareCode persisted on GET. POST /api/courses/import clones a course (new id, name suffixed ' (Shared)', 18 holes deep-copied, shareCode wiped to null on clone, isDemo=false), accepts lowercase, 404 on bad code, 400 on empty. PUT /api/courses/{id} preserves an existing shareCode when the client omits it. FRONTEND (mobile Expo web preview): Course Sharing UI — Courses screen shows import-course-btn and per-card course-share-<id> including course-share-demo-apo-davao. Tapping SHARE fires POST /api/courses/{id}/share and pops a native alert with the code (dialog accepted). IMPORT flow: import-course-btn -> import-course-dialog visible -> filled import-code-input='9W48B2' (a real code obtained via POST /api/courses/demo-apo-davao/share) -> tapped do-import-btn -> toast 'Imported "Apo Highlands Demo (DEMO DATA) (Shared)"' + new card 'Apo Highlands Demo (DEMO DATA) (Shared)' rendered under the list (screenshot). Auto Putt Prompt On Hole Change — Start Round -> /play (hole 1) -> SCORE tab -> score-plus x4 -> back to MAP -> tap rf-next-hole-btn -> putt-reminder-banner appears with title 'Log your putts · Hole 1' and putt-minus/putt-plus/putt-draft-value(initial 2)/putt-save-btn/putt-dismiss-btn all present. Tapping putt-plus increments draft to 3. Tapping putt-save-btn dismisses the banner and fires PUT /api/rounds/{id} (toast 'Logged 3 putts on Hole 1'). Hole Flyover — code-only verification: GolfMap.tsx L120-131 (m.animateCamera tee -> green over 500+2400ms driven by flyoverKey), play.tsx L114-118 bumps flyoverKey on holeIdx/course change; play.tsx L421-422 wires flyover={from:hole.tee,to:hole.greenCenter} + flyoverKey. Confirmed no runtime error and rangefinder distance card still updates on hole change (HOLE 1 CENTER 383 -> HOLE 2 CENTER 575 -> HOLE 3 CENTER 730 in screenshots). Regression: Courses list still loads, rangefinder F/C/B computes on every hole (562/575/589 for hole 2, 723/730/739 for hole 3), scorecard editing works (score-plus/putts-value/prev/next-hole-score-btn), SMART CADDIE strip still recommends 'DRIVER · 230 yd · LOW'. Deprecated packages/SafeAreaView issues: none newly introduced (same shadow*->boxShadow cosmetic warning as prior iterations).

integration_issues.flow: Auto Putt Prompt state sync between SCORE tab and MAP tab
integration_issues.issue: Play.tsx caches roundScores in a useEffect keyed only on activeRound (L227-230). When the SCORE tab patches a hole (e.g. sets score=4), Play never re-fetches on tab-focus, so its cached roundScores stays stale. Two consequences observed on the web preview: (1) After the putt-reminder banner SAVE (which PUTs the ENTIRE stale roundScores with only hole.putts overridden), the just-patched hole 1 score was wiped in the backend — reading back on SCORE tab shows putts="-" for hole 1 (expected 3). Effectively the banner Save nukes concurrent edits. (2) Second Auto Putt Prompt test: set score on hole 2 via SCORE tab, back to MAP, tap rf-next-hole-btn — banner did NOT appear because Play's cached roundScores never learned about the hole 2 score. Fix: reload roundScores on Play useFocusEffect and/or on tab focus, or use a shared context/subscription so both tabs read the same source of truth. Alternatively, savePutts should send a minimal PATCH (single hole update) rather than the whole scores array. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/play.tsx L227-259, L303-311.

react_native_issues.issue: Cosmetic deprecation warning carried over from prior iterations: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Not a regression, unchanged.

action_items: Fix Play.tsx roundScores staleness: on tab focus (useFocusEffect) re-fetch /api/rounds/{id} so it sees SCORE-tab edits before goHole() checks or savePutts() PUTs. Otherwise the putt banner SAVE overwrites hole scores set on the SCORE tab, and the next-hole trigger for holes edited on SCORE will silently skip.

Consider making savePutts (and goHole scores update) a minimal server-side PATCH — e.g. PUT/PATCH /api/rounds/{id}/holes/{n} — instead of replacing the entire scores array. This prevents cross-tab clobber even if state briefly desyncs.
OPTIONAL: also refresh roundScores after every hole change (goHole) so the reminder trigger uses the freshest data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/courses/{id} preserves shareCode only when the client omits it; if the client sends shareCode:null (some serializers do), the field is set to null and the code is lost. Consider treating null the same as missing when the row already has one, or storing shareCode in a separate document to avoid this class of bug.
server.py _new_share_code uses random.random (not secrets); collisions across 32^6 space are astronomically low but a secrets.choice would be trivially safer.

play.tsx L114-118 flyover trigger fires on every course/holeIdx change; if course reloads (cache re-hit) and holeIdx stays 0, flyoverKey still increments — harmless but causes an extra camera animation. Guard with a ref that stores the last (courseId, holeNumber) pair.

play.tsx savePutts (L248-259) sends the WHOLE roundScores array to PUT /api/rounds/{id}; combined with the stale-cache issue above, this becomes destructive. Prefer a merge on the server or a per-hole endpoint.

courses/index.tsx doImport (L36-48) only requires code.length >= 4 while the server generates 6-char codes; typos of 4-5 chars will hit the server as 404 rather than being caught client-side. Tighten to === 6 to give a faster UX signal.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + share/import UI + putt-banner UI all work. The remaining bug is a stale-state issue in play.tsx that causes the Save PUT to clobber Score-tab edits and the second-hole trigger to miss. Repro (all on mobile web preview): (a) Start round; (b) Score tab -> score-plus x4 on hole 1 (leave putts blank); (c) Map tab -> rf-next-hole-btn; (d) banner appears — tap putt-plus once, putt-save-btn; (e) Score tab -> prev-hole-score-btn -> putts-value shows '-' (should be 3) and score-value may also be blank in some flows. Fix per action_items; then re-run this iteration's UI script to green the persistence check and the dismiss retry. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_share_import.py is fast (~1.3s, 12 tests) and can be reused as regression.
rca of the issue: Play.tsx maintains its own copy of round.scores in state (roundScores), loaded once when activeRound reference changes (L227-230). The SCORE tab (score.tsx) mutates the server via PUT /api/rounds/{id} but does not notify Play, and Play does not re-fetch on tab focus. When savePutts fires it maps over Play's stale roundScores, overriding only hole.putts, then PUTs the whole array — wiping any score fields the Score tab had just written. The same staleness causes goHole()'s reminder check to miss score edits made after Play's initial fetch. Fix by re-fetching /api/rounds/{id} inside Play's useFocusEffect, or by moving to a shared subscription/context, or by switching the round score writes to a per-hole endpoint on the backend.
